definition: paired cross-view R1 minus same-view R1, percentage points

zero_positive_original_policy.evaluator: _offline_common.evaluate calls eligible_queries and skips no-positive queries
zero_positive_original_policy.source_exclusion: remove only the query source image before sorting
zero_positive_original_policy.common_queries: S11.common_query_sets intersects legal same-view and cross-view queries
zero_positive_original_policy.historical_sampling: preserve positives; same-view subsets also preserve every query source; no similarity-based sampling
zero_positive_original_policy.historical_sampler: S11.sample_gallery retains all same-view sources, >=2 same-view and >=1 cross-view positives per identity
zero_positive_original_policy.conclusion: saved S11 draws, not newly invented uniform draws, define the Table-5 reproduction

policies.a_fixed_misses: fixed common query set; no legal positive means a miss
policies.b_common_valid_queries: within each draw both directions use the same jointly-valid query set
policies.c_at_least_two_positives: retain >=2 original target-view images/identity in both directions; source-preserving same-view sampling

positive_retention_warning: c is label-stratified, raises positive retention, and is not uniform subsampling; impossible >=2 retention is reported, never relaxed
